source: This also explains why latency hiding and latency reduction are different. A cache hit may reduce the distance a request travels. Warp scheduling may instead overlap a long request with unrelated work. The underlying request did not necessarily become faster. Less of its wait became visible in wall-clock execution.
zh: 这也解释了为什么延迟隐藏和延迟减少是不同的。缓存命中可以减少请求传输的距离。 Warp 调度可能会将长请求与不相关的工作重叠。底层请求不一定会变得更快。在挂钟执行中可以看到更少的等待时间。
